# launchdarkly_experimentation_settings (Data Source)

Provides a LaunchDarkly experimentation settings data source.

This data source lets you retrieve the randomization units configured for experiments within a LaunchDarkly project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "launchdarkly_experimentation_settings" "example" {
  project_key = "example-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) The project key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique resource ID, which is equal to the `project_key`.
- `randomization_units` (Attributes Map) The randomization units available for experiments in this project, keyed by the randomization unit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--randomization_units))

<a id="nestedatt--randomization_units"></a>
### Nested Schema for `randomization_units`

Read-Only:

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this randomization unit is the default for experiments in the project.
- `display_name` (String) The display name for the randomization unit, shown in the LaunchDarkly user interface.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether this randomization unit is hidden in the LaunchDarkly user interface.
